verdict.rationale: Yubico publishes extensive developer documentation, so agent-readable docs are a fair question to ask, but runtime probes show no such surface. llms.txt returns HTTP 404 on docs.yubico.com, developers.yubico.com and www.yubico.com, and appending .md to doc pages returns 'Multiple Choices' rather than markdown. The probes confirm the docs are human-oriented HTML only.
